description: This Java class handles the approval command for loan applications within the Fineract project. It implements command processing for approving loan applications using the LoanApplicationWritePlatformService.

classes.name: LoanApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the approval command for loan applications, ensuring transactional execution and integrating with the loan application write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the approval command for a loan application by invoking the approveApplication method on the write platform service.
